description: image_transcribe refusing the uploaded screenshot uploads/ma-1855-census-josiah-barnes.png because no OpenRouter key is configured for this user (ut_search_external_sites_ulr). Production checks the key before it reads the file, so this is the answer whatever the upload holds. The error text is OPENROUTER_API_KEY_MISSING_MESSAGE in packages/engine/mcp-server/src/auth/config.ts, verbatim. Marked is_error because production returns a thrown error with isError: true, so nothing is staged. Its Claude Desktop and config.json steps do not apply to a hosted researcher; the agent asks for the results text instead.

response.error: No OpenRouter API key is configured. Tell the user to get one at https://openrouter.ai/keys and enter it in Claude Desktop under Settings → Extensions → Genealogy Research, or add it to ~/.familysearch-mcp/config.json as the "openRouterApiKey" field. Do not ask the user to paste the key into the chat.
